---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new capability for Nexus
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: p4inz-code
---

**Check [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/p4inz-code/nexus-desktop/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) first** — your idea might already be
planned, or might conflict with a deliberate design choice (e.g. Nexus is
intentionally offline-only with no cloud sync).

## What's the problem?

What are you trying to do that Nexus doesn't currently support well?

## What would you like to see?

Describe the feature or change you have in mind. If you have thoughts on
how it should work, include them — but the "what problem" above matters
more than the "how" for us to evaluate it.

## Workaround (if any)

Are you currently working around this somehow? How?

## Anything else?

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features elsewhere — anything that
helps explain the idea.
